use super::super::collections::operators::select::item::SelectItem; pub enum Kind { Select } pub struct RegisteredOperator { kind: Kind } impl RegisteredOperator { fn item(&self) -> &'static dyn super::super::collections::operators::interface::OperatorsItem { match self.kind { Kind::Select => &SelectItem } } } pub fn registered(kind: Kind) -> RegisteredOperator { RegisteredOperator { kind } }
